# opnsense_caddy_settings (Data Source)

Reads Caddy global settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_caddy_settings" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `acme_email` (String)
- `auto_https` (String)
- `enable_layer4` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `grace_period` (Number)
- `http_port` (Number)
- `http_versions` (Set of String)
- `https_port` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `listen_addresses` (Set of String)
- `log_level` (String)
- `plain_access_log` (Boolean)
- `plain_access_log_keep` (Number)
- `run_as_user` (String)
